Three destination questions.

beats.say: For any Indian company you study, ask three destination questions. One. In ten years, will customers need this business more than today, or less? Two. Is it doing things now that make that future more likely, even if they hurt this year's profit? Three. What would have to go wrong for it to end up somewhere much worse?
